# Synthetic GeoIP fixture

`GeoIP2-Country-Test.mmdb` comes from [MaxMind/MaxMind-DB test-data](https://github.com/maxmind/MaxMind-DB/tree/main/test-data).
The fetched Git blob is `530ef08f867510e22054609c638c87754d113be4`; the local SHA-256 is `fc12d6470b35b70bd3e4534dd433d3e262a6c73f7682f85c344e832d4190f02b`.

The fixture contains synthetic IPv4/IPv6 country records for deterministic Core tests, including JP `2001:218::/32` and GB `81.2.69.142/31`. It is test data, not an operational country database.

The upstream MIT license is preserved in [LICENSE-MIT](LICENSE-MIT).
